name: forecast-pack
title: Forecast pack
for_each: select id, name from periods where status = 'open' order by starts

sections.title: Period
sections.sql: select p.name as period, p.starts, p.ends, p.currency, p.guidance_cents, sum(f.quota_cents)::bigint as quota_cents, sum(f.won_cents)::bigint as won_cents, sum(f.commit_cents)::bigint as commit_cents, sum(f.best_case_cents)::bigint as best_case_cents, sum(f.call_commit_cents)::bigint as rep_calls_cents from periods p join v_forecast f on f.period_id = p.id where p.id = $1 group by p.name, p.starts, p.ends, p.currency, p.guidance_cents

sections.title: By rep
sections.sql: select rep, currency, quota_cents, won_cents, commit_cents, best_case_cents, call_commit_cents as rep_call_cents, gap_cents from v_forecast where period_id = $1 and (quota_cents > 0 or open_deals > 0) order by rep

sections.title: Commit deals
sections.sql: select deal, account, rep, stage, currency, amount_cents, close_date, next_step, next_step_on from v_deals where period_id = $1 and not is_closed and forecast_category = 'commit' order by amount_cents desc

sections.title: Risks on open deals
sections.sql: select deal, rep, risk, detail from v_deal_risk where period_id = $1 order by deal, risk

sections.title: Controls
sections.sql: select severity, rule, item, issue from v_compliance where $1::uuid is not null order by case severity when 'breach' then 1 else 2 end, rule

name: deal-review
title: Deal review sheet
for_each: select distinct r.id, r.deal as name from v_deal_risk r where r.forecast_category in ('commit', 'best_case') order by name

sections.title: Deal
sections.sql: select deal, account, rep, stage, probability, forecast_category as category, currency, amount_cents, close_date, next_step, next_step_on, last_activity_on, pushes from v_deals where id = $1

sections.title: Risks
sections.sql: select risk, detail from v_deal_risk where id = $1

sections.title: Changes
sections.sql: select changed_on, field, old_value as was, new_value as now, actor as by from opportunity_history where opportunity_id = $1 order by changed_on

sections.title: Recent activity
sections.sql: select happened_on, kind, note from activities where opportunity_id = $1 order by happened_on desc limit 10

name: accuracy-report
title: Period close: forecast accuracy
for_each: select id, name from periods where status = 'closed' order by starts

sections.title: Period
sections.sql: select name as period, starts, ends, currency, closed_at, closed_by from periods where id = $1

sections.title: Calls against results
sections.sql: select rep, currency, first_call_on, first_call_cents, last_call_cents, won_cents, first_call_error_pct, last_call_error_pct from v_accuracy where period_id = $1 order by rep

sections.title: Won deals
sections.sql: select deal, account, rep, currency, amount_cents, closed_on, contract_signed_on from v_deals where period_id = $1 and is_won order by closed_on
